test_description: Verify that setting a custom registry URL overrides the default and is used for example download, and that omitting it falls back to a documented default rather than a hardcoded org/repo
test_assertions: Custom registry URL from project.yaml is used for example download
Omission of registry config falls back to documented default
change_description: Replace hardcoded org/repo in downloadExampleFromGitHub with a configurable base URL read from project.yaml examples.registry.url, with the current hardcoded value as default
why_this_correction: Observe evidence: commands-add.ts line 615 hardcodes `https://api.github.com/repos/myanlabs/converge/contents/examples/` with the same org/repo repeated at line 628 for git clone. This is the highest-severity finding (high, Portability). Fixing it makes an entire class of 'hardcoded identifiers leak into framework' bugs impossible. The alternative finding (skill path construction) is a code-quality issue where behavior is still correct.
